rules.quote: Do not take the cell size from the stars `delta`
rules.rule: Do not derive the cell size of a raster bathymetry from the stars `delta` value; it differs from the plotted coordinate spacing by a floating-point margin.

rules.quote: Adding new map elements requires writing valid R that evaluates in `basemap()`'s local scope.
rules.rule: When adding a new map element to basemap(), write valid R code that evaluates in basemap()'s local scope.

rules.quote: Use RStudio's bundled copy:
rules.rule: When rendering with Rscript on this machine, use RStudio's bundled pandoc by setting RSTUDIO_PANDOC to /Applications/RStudio.app/Contents/Resources/app/quarto/bin/tools/aarch64.

rules.quote: set both the env var and `Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO_PANDOC=...)` inside the R call
rules.rule: When rendering with Rscript, set RSTUDIO_PANDOC both as an environment variable and via Sys.setenv(RSTUDIO_PANDOC=...) inside the R call.

rules.quote: Rebuild a single article: `pkgdown::build_article("bathymetry")`.
rules.rule: To rebuild a single pkgdown article, call pkgdown::build_article() with the article name, for example "bathymetry".

rules.quote: `GGOCEANMAPS_DATAPATH=$HOME/Documents/ggOceanMapsLargeData`
rules.rule: When rendering the ggOceanMaps.Rmd user manual, set the environment variable GGOCEANMAPS_DATAPATH to $HOME/Documents/ggOceanMapsLargeData.

rules.quote: `GGOCEANMAPS_USERPATH=~/path/to/GEBCO_2025.nc`
rules.rule: When rendering the ggOceanMaps.Rmd user manual, set the environment variable GGOCEANMAPS_USERPATH to the path of the user's raster file, such as ~/path/to/GEBCO_2025.nc.

rules.quote: To check chunks execute without pandoc, use `knitr::knit()` instead of `rmarkdown::render()`.
rules.rule: To check that R chunks execute without pandoc, use knitr::knit() instead of rmarkdown::render().

rules.quote: Do not include the user's local paths, machine-specific filenames, or other personal info in committed/published docs
rules.rule: Do not include the user's local paths, machine-specific filenames, or other personal info in committed or published docs (e.g., AGENTS.md, README, vignettes, cookbook recipes).

rules.quote: Use generic placeholders.
rules.rule: Use generic placeholders instead of personal info in committed or published docs.

rules.quote: For example file paths, use generic placeholders: `path/to/your/bathymetry.nc`, `~/path/to/data`, `<your-data-dir>`.
rules.rule: For example file paths in docs, use generic placeholders such as `path/to/your/bathymetry.nc`, `~/path/to/data`, or `<your-data-dir>`.

rules.quote: For example coordinates, use round numbers around well-known regions
rules.rule: For example coordinates in docs, use round numbers around well-known regions, not the user's actual research sites.

rules.quote: Before committing any public-facing doc, scan for: home directory paths, specific filenames the user has mentioned, dataset versions tied to a particular machine.
rules.rule: Before committing any public-facing doc, scan it for home directory paths, specific filenames the user has mentioned, and dataset versions tied to a particular machine.

rules.quote: Personal info ≠ authorship/canonical URLs in package metadata. Those are public and expected.
rules.rule: Do not treat authorship attribution or canonical project URLs in package metadata as personal info to remove from docs.

rules.quote: Use the dot.case naming style for function arguments
rules.rule: Use dot.case naming for function arguments (e.g., bathy.style, land.col) and do not switch to snake_case for new arguments.

rules.quote: Any new arguments added to basemap(), qmap(), transform_coord(), etc. should follow dot.case.
rules.rule: New arguments added to basemap(), qmap(), transform_coord(), etc. should use dot.case.

rules.quote: Internal helper functions are exported (`@export`) but marked `@keywords internal`. Follow this pattern for new internal helpers.
rules.rule: Export new internal helper functions with `@export` and mark them `@keywords internal`.

rules.quote: Use this for any new function that shares basemap parameters.
rules.rule: Use `@inheritParams basemap` for any new function that shares basemap parameters.

rules.quote: New functions with potentially chatty output should follow this pattern.
rules.rule: New functions with potentially chatty output should default the `verbose` argument to `FALSE`.

rules.quote: This is intentional and not noise to be removed.
rules.rule: Do not remove test parameters left as comments at the top of function definitions, since they are intentional for interactive debugging.

rules.quote: **pre-rendered and hosted remotely**, then embedded via raw.githubusercontent URLs
rules.rule: Pre-render vignette example figures that require downloads or fetches, host them remotely, and embed them via raw.githubusercontent URLs.

rules.quote: not bundling figures in the package
rules.rule: Do not bundle vignette figures in the ggOceanMaps package.

rules.quote: generate PNGs into the LargeData `docs/` folder
rules.rule: Generate vignette figure PNGs into the ggOceanMapsLargeData repo's `docs/` folder.

rules.quote: then commit & push that repo separately
rules.rule: Commit and push the ggOceanMapsLargeData repo separately from the ggOceanMaps repo after generating figures.

rules.quote: `git init` + `git remote add origin <url>` + `git fetch` + `git reset --mixed origin/master`
rules.rule: If the local ggOceanMapsLargeData clone has lost its .git, re-link it by running git init, git remote add origin <url>, git fetch, and git reset --mixed origin/master.

rules.quote: commit only the new files
rules.rule: After re-linking the ggOceanMapsLargeData clone, commit only the new figure files.

rules.quote: don't stage those
rules.rule: Do not stage unrelated files in the ggOceanMapsLargeData clone, such as .gitignore, data/.gitattributes, or data/dd_rbathy_cont.rda.

rules.quote: When editing `.Rmd`/`.qmd`/`.md` files, write each prose paragraph as a single unwrapped line (no hard line breaks at ~80 cols)
rules.rule: When editing .Rmd, .qmd, or .md files, write each prose paragraph as a single unwrapped line with no hard line breaks at about 80 columns.

rules.quote: normal R style/line lengths still apply
rules.rule: In code chunks within .Rmd or .qmd files, follow normal R style and line-length conventions instead of the unwrapped-prose rule.

rules.quote: Applies to all docs going forward, not just one file.
rules.rule: Apply the unwrapped-prose formatting rule to all Rmd, qmd, and markdown documents from now on, not only the file currently being edited.

rules.quote: See [[build-vignettes-locally]] for the render workflow.
rules.rule: Consult the build-vignettes-locally note for the render workflow when rendering these documents.

rules.quote: do NOT merge or submit
rules.rule: Do not merge the release branch or submit the tarball to CRAN; the maintainer does that after the rebuilt site is reviewed.

rules.quote: **Do NOT** merge PR #67 or do anything CRAN-related
rules.rule: Do not merge PR #67 or perform any CRAN-related step (Phase 5) unless the maintainer explicitly gives the go-ahead after reviewing the new features.

rules.quote: Do not merge or submit without explicit go-ahead.
rules.rule: Do not merge PR #67 or submit to CRAN without the maintainer's explicit go-ahead.

rules.quote: one line per paragraph
rules.rule: Write Rmd vignette prose with no hard wrapping: each paragraph is one line.

rules.quote: Reflow prose to single lines while preserving code fences, tables, and list items
rules.rule: When reflowing vignette prose, join wrapped lines into single lines, but leave code fences, tables, and list items intact.

rules.quote: fix whatever broke
rules.rule: If the pkgdown site build does not finish with zero errors and zero warnings, fix whatever caused the failure and rebuild.

rules.quote: Commit the regenerated `docs/`
rules.rule: After rebuilding the pkgdown site, commit the regenerated docs/ directory separately from code fixes, then push.

rules.quote: fix anything that reads wrong/stale
rules.rule: After rebuilding the site, walk the rendered pages and fix anything that reads wrong or stale.

rules.quote: Run from a non-interactive Rscript so `interactive()` is FALSE.
rules.rule: Run the CI-like R CMD check from a non-interactive Rscript so that interactive() returns FALSE.

rules.quote: Strip AeN references
rules.rule: When porting the workshop deck to a vignette, remove all AeN workshop references.

rules.quote: Keep canonical names stable (no renames in 2.4)
rules.rule: Keep canonical exported function names stable; do not rename functions in the 2.4 release.

rules.quote: Don't add dplyr to Imports for this.
rules.rule: Do not add dplyr to Imports for the vector_land() work; use base R or forcats instead.

rules.quote: replace with base R / forcats before merging
rules.rule: Replace dplyr::recode_factor in vector_land() with base R or forcats before merging.

rules.quote: tests must `skip_on_cran()` + `skip_if_offline()`
rules.rule: Network-dependent tests must call skip_on_cran() and skip_if_offline().

rules.quote: examples must not require internet
rules.rule: Roxygen examples must not require internet access.

rules.quote: Use small bundled fixture for tests.
rules.rule: Use a small bundled fixture for tests rather than downloaded data.

rules.quote: Client should respect timeout and degrade gracefully.
rules.rule: The WCS client must respect a request timeout and degrade gracefully on failure.

rules.quote: every exported fn has an example that runs in <2 s without downloads
rules.rule: Give every exported function a roxygen example that runs in under 2 seconds without downloads.

rules.quote: Skip machine-readable manifest
rules.rule: Do not create a machine-readable manifest; rely on the cookbook and AGENTS.md instead.

rules.quote: Default in 2.4.0 stays the current default
rules.rule: Keep the existing default bathymetry style in 2.4.0; do not change it.

rules.quote: New WCS options must be well documented.
rules.rule: Document all new WCS bathymetry options thoroughly.

rules.quote: keep both, regenerate `.md`
rules.rule: Keep both README.Rmd and README.md, and regenerate README.md from README.Rmd.

rules.quote: Key decisions to FLAG at review
rules.rule: Flag the listed key decisions explicitly in the report for the maintainer's review.

rules.quote: Bump nothing (already 2.4.0)
rules.rule: Do not bump the package version as part of the release tail.

rules.quote: When suggesting features or fixes, consider CRAN policy constraints
rules.rule: When suggesting features or fixes for ggOceanMaps, consider CRAN policy constraints.

rules.quote: no persistent writes to user directories without permission
rules.rule: Do not make persistent writes to user directories without the user's permission.

rules.quote: no auto-downloads without user consent
rules.rule: Do not auto-download data without the user's consent.

rules.quote: High-res data downloads must remain interactive (user-prompted).
rules.rule: Keep high-resolution data downloads interactive, prompting the user before downloading.

rules.quote: assume deep R knowledge
rules.rule: When helping the user with R code, assume they have deep R knowledge.

rules.quote: familiarity with sf/stars/ggplot2 spatial ecosystem
rules.rule: When helping the user, assume they are familiar with the sf, stars, and ggplot2 spatial ecosystem.

rules.quote: that marine/oceanographic terminology is understood
rules.rule: When helping the user, assume that marine and oceanographic terminology is understood without needing explanation.
